verdicts.reason: Both are essentially rescaled copies of the original rather than real rearrangements. Both keep the original's flaw of the subhead jammed against the CTA pill with almost no gap, the headline has little presence for a portrait format, and the 'New Flavor' badge floats unanchored on the big translucent circle. B adds a looser, uneven gap between the can, the headline and the subhead (about 90px before the subhead), which pulls the headline group apart. A keeps the can, headline, subhead and CTA more tightly grouped with more even top and bottom margins, so it is the slightly less flawed of two near-identical layouts.
